title: 꿈 이야기하기: 미래에 뭐가 되고 싶어요?
objective: By the end, you can use words like 꿈, 목표, 노력하다, and 이루다 in short sentences to say what you want to become and what you are doing to get there.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for talking about your dreams, goals, and plans for the future.

task.title: Use the dream words
task.line: Read each sentence, think about what it means, and choose or write the word that fits best.

words.meaning: dream (something you hope to do or become)
words.example: 제 꿈은 한국에서 작은 가게를 여는 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: My dream is to open a small shop in Korea.
What kind of work do you want to do in the future?

words.example: 올해 목표는 책 열 권 읽기예요.
words.exampleMeaning: My goal this year is to read ten books.

words.example: 저는 매일 아침에 하루 계획을 써요.
words.exampleMeaning: Every morning I write down my plan for the day.

words.meaning: to set up, to make (a goal or plan)
words.exampleMeaning: I set a new goal for the new year.

words.meaning: to try hard, to make an effort
words.exampleMeaning: I want to be good at Korean, so I try hard every day.

words.meaning: to achieve, to make (a dream or goal) come true
words.exampleMeaning: My older sister worked hard for a long time and made her dream come true.
Don't give up, even if it's hard.

words.example: 저는 사람을 돕는 직업을 갖고 싶어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I want to have a job where I help people.

words.example: 동생은 나중에 간호사가 되고 싶어 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling wants to become a nurse someday.

exercises: Choose the right word (꿈 / 직업): ① 저는 지금 은행에서 일해요. 제 ____은 은행원이에요. ② 선생님은 학생들에게 "큰 ____을 가지세요!"라고 말했어요.
Fill in the blank with 이 or 가: ① 저는 나중에 선생님____ 되고 싶어요. ② 제 친구는 작년에 배우____ 되었어요.
Fill in the blank with 노력해서, 포기하지, or 이뤘어요: ① 그 배우는 오랫동안 ____ 유명해졌어요. ② 비가 와도 등산을 ____ 않았어요. ③ 할머니는 일흔 살에 대학생이 되는 꿈을 ____.
Choose the verb that fits: ① 친구와 여행 계획을 (세웠어요 / 노력했어요). ② 형은 의사가 (되었어요 / 세웠어요). ③ 건강해지려고 매일 (노력해요 / 세워요).
Write the Korean word from this worksheet: ① the time that has not come yet ② the work you do to earn money
Put the words in the right order to make a sentence: 세웠어요 / 친구와 / 계획을 / 여름 방학
answers: ① 노력해서 ② 포기하지 ③ 이뤘어요 (이루었어요)
① 세웠어요 ② 되었어요 ③ 노력해요
친구와 여름 방학 계획을 세웠어요. (여름 방학 계획을 친구와 세웠어요.)
